Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: first-person point-and-click castle exploration game background. Generate ONE full-bleed landscape 1536x1024 image, 3:2. The SAME inhabited medium-sized western fantasy lord's castle throughout: fine realistic painted environmental concept art, pale warm-gray limestone ashlar and restrained pointed arches, deeply textured dark oak, small aged bronze fittings, muted wine-red cloth and natural linen where suitable. Beautiful tactile materials, crisp legible architectural edges, coherent rigid perspective and believable human-sized construction. Standing eye-level viewpoint, natural wide angle, complete readable room with foreground depth, finished environmental painting. Soft cool daylight balanced with small warm household light, calm cared-for lived-in atmosphere, no exaggerated palace scale. No people, readable words, UI, navigation arrows, hotspot outlines, return-button graphics, watermark, collage, modern objects, magical effects, banners with heraldic emblems or named-world symbols. Keep the architecture functional and coherent.
Scene: the SERVANTS' COMMON REST ROOM off the service corridor, ground floor. The entrance is BEHIND THE CAMERA and outside the frame. This room is a branch endpoint: NO visible onward doors, open passages, stairways, secret exits, balconies or additional rooms. Cupboard doors are visibly furniture, not floor-to-ceiling architectural doors. Do not invent other navigation destinations.
A comfortable collective sitting room around 3.3m high, broad enough for several household workers to gather, plain pale limestone walls, dark oak beams and a clean flagstone floor warmed by a worn woven rug. A modest stone fireplace on the REAR LEFT glows gently; near it are two sturdy comfortable wooden armchairs with plain muted-wine-red cushions, angled toward the room rather than symmetrically posed. CENTER RIGHT a simple round-to-oval oak common table with three plain chairs and a small bench provides space for conversation and mending. The table carries an earthenware jug, a few mismatched ceramic cups, one folded cloth and a shallow bowl, not a banquet setting. A tall leaded window on the RIGHT brightens a deep built-in stone window seat with practical linen cushions. A low closed oak cabinet against a solid rear wall and a couple of plain wooden coat pegs complete the usable furnishings. Keep the central walking space and approach to the hearth open. The room should feel hospitable, informal and maintained, visually distinct from both the servants' bedrooms and the lord's formal dining room. Use warm fire reflections with cool window light, rich tactile stone, wood and woven cloth, no glossy luxury. No beds, bunk room, alehouse bar, gaming icons, named or written notices, modern sofa, enormous banquet table, doorway beside fireplace or other visible exit.
